note: Poll-close table for election day (season.js). 17 of 51 entries were read against a state election office page: CA, CT, DE, ID, KS, KY, MD, MI, NC, ND, NE, NJ, NM, NY, OK, TX, VA. The other entries are still unconfirmed, so the card tells members to confirm with their state election office. For states split across zones the LATER zone is shown (county-level times are not here). tz is an IANA zone, close is the local clock time on election day.

AK.note: Aleutian Islands (Hawaii-Aleutian time) close at 8 pm their time, one hour later.

FL.note: Split zone: most of the state closes 7 pm Eastern; the western Panhandle closes 7 pm Central. Later zone shown.

IA.note: Polls close at 8 p.m. (7 a.m. to 8 p.m.), per Iowa election pages.

ID.note: Split zone: most of the state closes 8 pm Mountain; the northern Panhandle closes 8 pm Pacific. Later zone shown.

IN.note: Split zone: most of the state closes 6 pm Eastern; northwest and southwest counties close 6 pm Central. Later zone shown.

KS.note: Split zone: most of the state closes 7 pm Central; a few western counties close 7 pm Mountain. Later zone shown.

KY.note: Split zone: eastern part closes 6 pm Eastern; western part closes 6 pm Central. Later zone shown.

MI.note: Split zone: most of the state closes 8 pm Eastern; four Upper Peninsula counties close 8 pm Central. Later zone shown.

ND.note: Split zone: most of the state closes 7 pm Central; southwest closes 7 pm Mountain. Later zone shown.

NE.note: Split zone: eastern part closes 8 pm Central; western part closes 8 pm Mountain. Later zone shown.

NH.note: Some towns close later (up to 8 pm). Check your town clerk.

OR.note: Split zone: Malheur County (east) closes 8 pm Mountain. Pacific time shown.

SD.note: Split zone: eastern part closes 7 pm Central; western part closes 7 pm Mountain. Later zone shown.

TN.note: Split zone: eastern part closes 7 pm Eastern; the rest closes 7 pm Central. Later zone shown.

TX.note: Split zone: most of the state closes 7 pm Central; El Paso and Hudspeth counties close 7 pm Mountain. Later zone shown.
